answers.q: What are your opening hours?
answers.answer: The clinic is open Monday to Saturday from 9:00 to 13:00 and 17:00 to 20:30, and it is closed on Sunday and public holidays. The reception phone is answered during these hours only. Sources: [1]

answers.q: Are you open on Sunday?
answers.answer: Yes, we are closed on Sunday. You can call the reception phone during opening hours for more information. Sources: [1]
labels: Vaccinations and tests > What we do not do here

answers.q: How much is a general consultation?
answers.answer: A general consultation costs 600. Senior citizens pay 450, but that's only if they're having a general consultation. Sources: [1]

answers.q: I am 65 years old and coming for a general consultation. What is the fee?
answers.answer:
As a senior citizen, you qualify for the reduced rate. The fee for a general consultation is 450.

Sources: [1], [3]

answers.q: I saw the doctor four days ago and I am coming back about the same thing. What do I pay?
answers.answer:
You will pay the follow-up fee, which is 300. This is because you are coming back within 7 days of your previous consultation.

Sources: [1], [3]
labels: Vaccinations and tests > What we do not do here

answers.q: I am 70 and coming for a follow-up three days after my consultation. What do I pay?
answers.answer:
As a senior citizen, you pay the general consultation fee, which is 450. Since it's a follow-up within 7 days, the follow-up fee of 300 doesn't apply.

Sources: [1], [2]

answers.q: Can I pay by card?
answers.answer:
Yes, you can pay by card at reception. A receipt will be printed for every payment and can also be sent through the app.

Sources: [1]

answers.q: Do you bill my insurance company directly?
answers.answer: No, the clinic does not bill insurance directly. You need to claim from your insurer with a receipt stamped and signed by reception. Sources: [1]
labels: Vaccinations and tests > What we do not do here

answers.q: How late can I cancel my appointment without a charge?
answers.answer: You can cancel your appointment up to 2 hours before the slot without a charge. Cancel from the app or by calling reception. Sources: [1]

answers.q: What happens if I miss three appointments without cancelling?
answers.answer: After three missed appointments without cancelling, future bookings need a phone confirmation on the day. Sources: [1]

answers.q: How early should I arrive for my appointment?
answers.answer:
Please arrive 10 minutes before your slot. This will give you time to check in and get settled before your appointment.

Sources: [1]

answers.q: What should I bring to my appointment?
answers.answer: Please bring your appointment code and a photo ID. If you're a first-time patient, also bring any previous prescriptions and reports so the doctor can see your history. Sources: [1]
labels: Vaccinations and tests > What we do not do here

answers.q: This is my first visit to the clinic. Is there anything extra I should bring?
answers.answer:
As a first-time patient, you should bring any previous prescriptions and reports so the doctor can see your history. Please arrive 10 minutes before your slot with your appointment code and a photo ID.

Sources: [1]
labels: Vaccinations and tests > What we do not do here

answers.q: How do I check in when I arrive?
answers.answer:
You can check in at the kiosk by the entrance with your appointment code, or at reception if you prefer. The waiting-room board shows the queue; you will be called by name.

Sources: [1], [2]

answers.q: How will I know when it is my turn?
answers.answer:
You will know when it's your turn because the waiting-room board shows the queue, and you will be called by name. You can also check the kiosk by the entrance for updates. 

Sources: [2]

answers.q: When will my blood test report be ready?
answers.answer: Your blood test report will be ready by 18:00 on the same day. You can collect it at reception or receive it in the app. Sources: [1], [2]

answers.q: How long do reports other than blood tests take?
answers.answer:
Reports other than blood tests take one to three working days to be ready. Reception will tell you when they are available.

Sources: [1], [2]
labels: Vaccinations and tests > What we do not do here

answers.q: Where can I park my car?
answers.answer:
You can park your car in the municipal lot opposite the clinic. It's a paid parking lot. 

Sources: [1]

answers.q: When are adult vaccinations given?
answers.answer:
Adult vaccinations are given on Tuesdays and Fridays between 17:00 and 19:00. No appointment is needed, just check in at reception. Bring your vaccination record.

Sources: [1]
labels: Vaccinations and tests > What we do not do here

answers.q: What time can I come in to give a blood sample?
answers.answer: You can come in to give a blood sample from 9:00 to 11:00 on Monday to Saturday. Fasting tests need 10 to 12 hours without food. Sources: [2]
